note: Two orbits of Z_7 acting on R^4 by rot(2pi/7)+rot(4pi/7) (vertices 0..6 and 7..13); vertex map equivariant for rot(2pi/7)+rot(6pi/7). The integer data are the floating-point configuration in 'source' rounded with exponent scale 60 (largest coordinate -> 60, then shifted to be >= 0) and coefficient scale 20, no perturbation. Boundary of the convex hull of polytope_points: exactly 'facets' (exact integer arithmetic; all 2002 5x5 minors nonzero). All 1001 4x4 minors of C nonzero. Bihan's formula (arXiv:2611.34336 Thm 1.3) gives deg F = -16 at every generic u tested (6136 by the referee). Independent of Bihan's theorem: the system has exactly 30 positive solutions, 7 with positive and 23 with negative Jacobian, signed sum -16 (referee; existence, uniqueness and signs in exact rational interval arithmetic, completeness inside the cube |log x| <= 8 by floating-point interval branch and bound). C has three zero entries (C[0][5], C[2][1], C[2][12]), so the first and third polynomial have 13 and 12 monomials; the system as a whole has 14 and (U_C) holds. Previous lower bound for N = 14: 15 (our note in n4-bounds, Corollary: (N-2)(N-4)/8 for even N, explicit system in that folder). Best value known on a 14-vertex 3-sphere: 17 (n4-records, not polytopal).
